name: dodecahedral-graph-hamiltonicity-and-a-declared-icosian-analogue
authority: Research 0129 section 3; this contract authorizes one bounded run and nothing else
agreed_with: Mingli Yuan, 2026-09-13; approved as presented, six parts unchanged

question_and_level.question: For the dodecahedral graph G (20 vertices, 30 edges) obtained from two independent constructions, how many Hamiltonian cycles exist under the declared equivalences, how many satisfy a declared Icosian-style local rule, and do the declared controls show the checker is not vacuous?
question_and_level.requested_conclusion: exact finite counts with witnesses, plus the control outcomes
question_and_level.witness_that_resolves_it: an exact enumeration certificate (counts and the complete cycle list within the declared budget), or an exhaustion report
question_and_level.counterexample_that_resolves_it: an explicit cycle that the declared conventions require to be counted and that is missing, or one counted that violates them
question_and_level.level: computation-level finite exact arithmetic in Z[phi], phi^2 = phi + 1
non_goals: no claim about the historical rule of Hamilton's Icosian game, which is not sourced here
no claim linking Hamiltonicity to the hyperbolic compactification of Research 0072: there is no interface justification, so that part is retained as a preflight obstruction and is not executed
no claim about icosahedral symmetry groups beyond the checks declared here

constructions.G1: the standard dodecahedron coordinates in Z[phi]: (+-1,+-1,+-1), (0,+-1/phi,+-phi), (+-1/phi,+-phi,0), (+-phi,0,+-1/phi); adjacency is the minimal squared distance computed exactly
constructions.G2: the dual of the twelve-vertex icosahedron already checked by the golden-ratio calibration: reuse its vertex set, its (p+q*sqrt5)/2 encoding and its 20 faces; adjacency is a shared icosahedron edge

imported_facts: the dodecahedral graph is the 1-skeleton of the regular dodecahedron: 3-regular, planar, 20 vertices, 30 edges, 12 pentagonal faces
the Petersen graph is not Hamiltonian (classical; used as a negative control and compared after the run)
for K4 and C_n the counts follow from (n-1)!/2 and from the single cyclic order respectively (derived, not imported)
imported_knowledge.explicit_non_import: the number of Hamiltonian cycles of the dodecahedral graph is not imported and not presupposed: it is the output of the run. Any later comparison with literature is made after the run and a mismatch is retained as a residual.
imported_knowledge.interface_justification: both constructions live in the same exact field and reuse the repository's existing encoding; the required equality is graph isomorphism under an exhibited explicit bijection, which is a finite exact check and imports no physical or hyperbolic interpretation

interface.translated: icosahedron vertices and faces (existing calibration) to the dual 20-vertex graph; standard dodecahedron coordinates to the same graph
interface.required_equality: an explicit vertex bijection preserving adjacency, checked exactly, with no numerical tolerance
interface.retained: exact field arithmetic with no floating point on the mathematics; each construction's vertex indexing; the face sets; the cycle lists in each indexing
interface.forgotten: the embedding in R^3 (positions determine adjacency only) and any geometric meaning of the cycles
interface.justification: the equality required is finite and exact; no physical or hyperbolic interpretation is imported

protected_obligations: Rust remains the sole semantic authority: no native type, no ProgramTerm, no Seal is introduced
no docs/claims.toml entry; at most a bounded external calibration record

the hyperbolic-compactification results (Research 0072: ordinary compactification does not raise dimension, H-bar^2 = H^2 union S^1_infinity = D^2) must not be contradicted, extended or reinterpreted here, and must not be cited as support
the executed rows of the golden-ratio calibration stay as they are: they may be cited, not re-pinned or reinterpreted
graph Hamiltonicity and the physical Hamiltonian of Research 0106 must be kept apart in the artifact's vocabulary

candidate_family_fixed_before_search.G2: dual of the repository's icosahedron, 20 vertices

acceptance_and_verification.checker: one deterministic Python program, experiments/dodecahedral_hamiltonicity/checker.py; external oracle, not native authority; no randomness

declared_equivalences.oriented_rooted_at_fixed_vertex: cycles reported as sequences from a fixed start vertex with a direction
declared_equivalences.undirected_unrooted: oriented rooted cycles modulo the 2n rotations and reversals, canonicalised

acceptance_and_verification.declared_icosian_style_rule: this repository's own declared analogue, explicitly not the historical rule: a cycle satisfies the rule when some five of its consecutive vertices are exactly the five vertices of one pentagonal face

derived: C_n has one undirected Hamiltonian cycle
a graph with a cut vertex has none
computed_and_cross_checked: cube Q3, by depth-first enumeration and by an independent bitmask dynamic program

cross_checks: G1 and G2 must give identical counts
oriented rooted must equal twice undirected at every step
the isomorphism witness must be exhibited and verified
the twelve per-face counts must be equal
acceptance_and_verification.success_condition: all counts computed, G1 = G2, the isomorphism verified, and every control matching its declared source
acceptance_and_verification.unresolved_outcome: budget exhaustion reports Unknown with the retained partial counts; a checker that reports zero for everything fails the positive controls and one that reports nonzero for everything fails Petersen and the cut-vertex control

resources_and_exit.continuation: none; a second run needs a new contract; no fuel reset and no scope widening
exit_conditions: budget exhaustion, reported as Unknown with the residual
interface failure (the two constructions are not isomorphic), reported as a stop with no search

deviation_note: The Herschel graph was named as a control in the approved contract. Its edge list was not sourced during the run, so it is not used; a derivable cut-vertex control takes its place and the deviation is retained in the evidence and the note rather than silently repaired.
